The verification process might take at least an hour. After the process completes, refresh the
Indicators tab. If your tenant is validated successfully, you see the list of IOCs displayed in this
section.
If you still don't have access to the Indicators section after going through the verification
process, contact the email address displayed on the page.

Understand the analyst report section
Proactively find threats with advanced hunting

７ Note
In some cases, we might require additional information during the verification process. We
communicate these requirements through email.
